display.purpose: Hero headlines only. Cormorant Garamond in 600 weight; italic variant for the accented line.

headline.purpose: Section headings (h2). Fluid scale from 2.2rem to 3.4rem.

title.purpose: Card headings, modal titles, sub-section labels. Fixed 1.35rem.

body.purpose: All prose. Inter only. 65–75ch max line length.

label.purpose: Uppercase kickers, nav links, badge text. One per section max.

shadows.name: shadow-sm
shadows.purpose: Cards at rest. Default surface elevation.

shadows.name: shadow-xl
shadows.purpose: Property cards on hover — the invitation state.

shadows.name: shadow-gold-lg
shadows.purpose: Gold buttons on hover — broader and softer.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Default easing. Fast deceleration — feels snappy and premium.

motion.name: ease-in-out
motion.purpose: Transitions with symmetric entry and exit. Nav color shifts.

motion.name: ease-spring
motion.purpose: Micro-interactions with slight overshoot (favorite button scale). Do not use for layout transitions.

motion.name: duration-fast
motion.purpose: Hover state color transitions, icon fills.

motion.name: duration-normal
motion.purpose: Card lifts, button hover, most interactive transitions.

motion.name: duration-slow
motion.purpose: Nav scroll state transition, page-level layout changes.

motion.name: duration-slower
motion.purpose: Hero image zoom, entrance reveal animations.

breakpoints.name: mobile
breakpoints.purpose: Sidebar collapses to overlay; hero goes single-column.

breakpoints.name: tablet
breakpoints.purpose: Property grid shifts from 3 to 2 columns.

components.name: Primary Button (Gold)
components.description: Main booking CTA. Pill-shaped, gold gradient, lifts on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 15px 36px; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #0B1526; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #C9A84C 0%, #D9BF70 100%); border: none; border-radius: 9999px; box-shadow: 0 6px 30px rgba(185,146,42,0.30); cursor: pointer; transition: all 300ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); position: relative; overflow: hidden; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-btn-primary::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; opacity: 0; background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.15), transparent); transition: opacity 300ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 16px 60px rgba(185,146,42,0.22); } .ds-btn-primary:hover::before { opacity: 1; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(201,168,76,0.60); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Navy Button
components.description: Secondary CTA on light surfaces or as a dark complement to gold.
components.css: .ds-btn-navy { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 15px 36px; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #FFFFFF; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #182844, #111E35); border: none; border-radius: 9999px; box-shadow: 0 6px 30px rgba(11,21,38,0.40); cursor: pointer; transition: all 300ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-navy:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 20px 60px rgba(11,21,38,0.50); } .ds-btn-navy:active { transform: translateY(0); } .ds-btn-navy:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(201,168,76,0.60); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Outline Button (on dark)
components.description: Secondary action in dark (hero/navy) contexts. Glass-tinted.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 15px 36px; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #FFFFFF; background: transparent; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.35); border-radius: 9999px; backdrop-filter: blur(12px); cursor: pointer; transition: all 300ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.10); border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.70); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.50); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Property Card
components.description: The brand's primary content unit. White surface, generous radius, dramatic hover lift.
components.html:
STR / MTR

West Virginia

The Pink Suite Experience

An Instagram-worthy retreat with curated neon signs and ultra-plush furnishings.
components.css: .ds-property-card { background: #FFFFFF; border-radius: 28px; overflow: hidden; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.08); border: 1px solid rgba(14,14,14,0.06); cursor: pointer; transition: all 300ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-property-card:hover { transform: translateY(-8px); box-shadow: 0 24px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.18); border-color: transparent; } .ds-property-card__image { height: 260px; overflow: hidden; position: relative; background: #F5F0E5; } .ds-property-card__image img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; transition: transform 800ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-property-card:hover .ds-property-card__image img { transform: scale(1.06); } .ds-property-card__overlay { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: linear-gradient(180deg, transparent 50%, rgba(7,14,26,0.30) 100%); pointer-events: none; } .ds-property-card__badge { position: absolute; top: 16px; left: 16px; } .ds-property-card__badge-item { background: rgba(7,14,26,0.75); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); color: #D9BF70; padding: 5px 12px; border-radius: 9999px; font-size: 0.66rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; border: 1px solid rgba(201,168,76,0.18); } .ds-property-card__body { padding: 32px; } .ds-property-card__location { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.18em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #B8922A; margin-bottom: 8px; } .ds-property-card__title { font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', Georgia, serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.35rem; line-height: 1.3; color: #111E35; margin-bottom: 10px; } .ds-property-card__desc { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.6; color: rgba(14,14,14,0.60); }

components.name: Form Input (on dark)
components.description: Search and contact form inputs — appear on navy/dark backgrounds.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; } .ds-field__label { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.18em; text-transform: uppercase; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.50); } .ds-input { padding: 12px 16px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12); border-radius: 12px; color: #FFFFFF; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 0.88rem; line-height: 1.5; outline: none; width: 100%; transition: all 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.30); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #C9A84C; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.12); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(201,168,76,0.15); }

components.name: Navigation (scrolled state)
components.description: Fixed header. Transparent on load; dark glass on scroll. Gold underline on active/hover.
components.html:
Travellir
PropertiesAboutContact
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 0 32px; height: 72px; background: rgba(7,14,26,0.88); backdrop-filter: blur(28px) saturate(200%); box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.06), 0 4px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.3); } .ds-nav__logo { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.1rem; color: #FFFFFF; letter-spacing: -0.01em; } .ds-nav__links { display: flex; gap: 48px; } .ds-nav__link { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 0.82rem; font-weight: 500; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.70); letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; position: relative; padding: 4px 0; text-decoration: none; transition: color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-nav__link::after { content: ''; position: absolute; bottom: -3px; left: 0; width: 0; height: 1px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, #C9A84C, #D9BF70); transition: width 300ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-nav__link:hover, .ds-nav__link--active { color: #FFFFFF; } .ds-nav__link:hover::after, .ds-nav__link--active::after { width: 100%; }

components.name: Ornament Divider
components.description: Brand signature decorative element. Appears between section label and section heading. Use once per section.
components.css: .ds-ornament { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; justify-content: center; margin-bottom: 32px; } .ds-ornament__line { flex: 1; max-width: 80px; height: 1px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, #C9A84C, transparent); } .ds-ornament__icon { font-size: 1rem; color: #B8922A; line-height: 1; }

narrative.overview:
Travellir's design system is built around one feeling: the moment you arrive somewhere you chose wisely. Not the anxiety of the search, not the hedge of the booking confirmation — the exhale of walking through a door and knowing you got it right. Every screen should carry that certainty.

The visual language is navy, ivory, and gold — the colors of a private club, a ship's logbook, a well-worn nautical chart. But the palette is directionally expanding: red joins white, navy, and gold to build a palette that reads as quintessentially American without waving a flag.

The tone throughout is confident restraint. Luxury isn't decorated here; it's expressed through generous spacing, photographic quality, and the absence of pressure. The guest should never feel sold to. They should feel discovered.
keyCharacteristics: Deep navy grounds the brand in depth and trust; gold warms it into approachability
Cormorant Garamond carries the editorial weight of curation; Inter carries utility without competing
Pill-shaped buttons throughout — rounded, unhurried, tactile
Property cards with dramatic hover lift (-8px + shadow-xl) — each card is an invitation
Ornament dividers (✦) as the brand's signature decorative device
Cinematic noise texture and radial gold glows on dark surfaces; subtle, not decorative

rules.name: The Warmth Rule
rules.body: Gold never appears without navy nearby. Used alone, gold reads as decoration. Anchored against deep navy, it reads as warmth.

rules.name: The Arrival Rule
rules.body: The palette transitions throughout a page: dark navy hero → ivory mid-sections → navy footer. The guest 'arrives in the light' and 'departs into depth.'

rules.name: The One Serif Rule
rules.body: Cormorant Garamond is the editorial voice. It appears in headlines only — never in body text, captions, nav, or form labels.

rules.name: The Label Ceiling
rules.body: Uppercase tracked labels (.text-label) may appear once per section as a named, deliberate system — not above every heading.

rules.name: The State-Only Rule
rules.body: Shadows escalate with interaction; they never appear on static decorative elements. Shadow growth is reserved for state change, not hierarchy decoration.

dos: Do use navy (#111E35 or deeper) as the dark surface — not charcoal, not true black.
Do let imagery do the emotional work in hero sections. One decisive, place-specific photograph beats five generic ones.
Do use Cormorant Garamond for all headings and Inter for all body text and UI. Never swap.
Do give gold (#C9A84C) a warm shadow — shadow-gold. Gold on navy with no shadow reads flat.
Do write property copy as if a trusted friend is recommending the place. Specific, warm, first-person.
Do elevate red (#C94040) to a brand accent alongside gold — geographic markers, availability badges, high-emphasis moments.
Do use pill buttons (radius-full) for all primary CTAs.
Do vary section spacing for rhythm.
donts: Don't design any screen that looks like it belongs on Marriott.com or any loyalty-program hotel site.
Don't design any screen that looks like an Airbnb or VRBO browse page.
Don't use gradient text (-webkit-background-clip: text) outside the hero display headline.
Don't use a .text-label kicker above more than one section heading per page.
Don't use side-stripe borders (border-left > 1px) as colored card accents.
Don't place identical card grids (same size, icon + heading + text) on any brand surface.
Don't use Inter in hero headlines or Cormorant Garamond in nav, labels, or form fields.
Don't use a warm cream/sand/beige body background — --ivory (#FEFCF7) is the correct page ground.
Don't let red appear without intention. #C94040 is reserved for errors and deliberate brand accents.
